sourceChoices.label: Fire Urchin (21): Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Fire Urchin gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
Ral's Staticaster (2): Whenever Ral's Staticaster attacks, if you control a Ral planeswalker, Ral's Staticaster gets +1/+0 for each card in your hand until end of turn.
Hellkite Whelp (60): Whenever Hellkite Whelp attacks, it deals 1 damage to target creature defending player controls.
